item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I helped Shebleha with some of his tone edits when this was in the re-edit stage, but there do still seem to be some rather… startling tone shifts.

I do like the effect, though. It's not just obsession, but also the ability to locate this thing anywhere. Security breaches are no one's friends.

I would like to see something about what happens when 2 simultaneously affected people find it at the same time. "It's mine!" "No, it's mine!" "I KEEL JOO!!!" "Bring it, mofo!"

I really wish I could like this, but its just a thing what mkes you obsessed. I mean, interesting things are almost here… but never go anywhere. Hopefully Sheb might be able to spruce this one up after getting review feedback.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
it is possible that another person will pick it up and become similarly obsessed with it; this has led to an unknown number of individuals actively seeking SCP-653.

Whoa man. See, I love these articles with climaxes like this. You know, right in the middle, so you can think about them while you read the rest of it. +1

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: In terms of ending the world on its own, I'd say Safe. On the other hand, the fact that it attracts onlookers who will find Foundation Sites seems dangerous. I suppose that as long as it remains contained, it's not much of an issue, as sooner or later, the Foundation will run out of people who've encountered it as they're killed^Kmindwiped on arrival. Either that, or the Foundation could start moving it on a random basis, but that increases the chance of it getting intercepted at some point.
